before.title: a mix of A and B

after.content: A 與 B 的混合／組合；a mix 是名詞片語。

patches.reason: Refine the noun-phrase Chinese, not a claim the entire inherited meaning was wrong.

before.title: a mixture of A and B

after.content: A 與 B 的混合物／混合；a mixture 是名詞片語。

patches.reason: Refine the noun-phrase Chinese while keeping the same two components.

after.content: Chinese cabbage 常指結球白菜／大白菜；bok choy（亦作 pak choi）常指小白菜、青江菜等。原題名的等號是教材簡化，不能把這些菜名一概當作相同品種。

patches.reason: Retain the original title/source but correct its overbroad botanical equivalence using the official bilingual product list.

after.content: 可指變得極度興奮、憤怒或失去控制；教材的分手情境指氣瘋、大發雷霆。

patches.reason: Keep the actual anger context and distinguish the broader idiom.

after.content: have a thin skin：容易因批評、玩笑等受傷；have a thick skin：不容易因批評而難過、不受影響。也可按字面指皮薄／皮厚；不能把 thick skin 一律理解為無恥。

patches.reason: Clarify the common criticism-sensitivity idiom rather than only give an ambiguous literal Chinese analogy.

before.title: mention + N / V-ing / that 子句
before.content: 表示「提到……」，後面通常不加 about。例：Ella mentioned meeting you at the science fair.

after.content: 表示「提到……」，可直接接 N、V-ing 或 that 子句，不寫 mention about sth；但 mention anything about sth 中的 about 可修飾 anything。例：Ella mentioned meeting you at the science fair.

patches.reason: Keep the exact existing Ella example and distinguish a direct complement from the unchanged EXc77efbd5 anything about pattern.

after.content: 與某人建立人脈、交流聯繫，尤指為工作或商業目的。

patches.reason: Align with the existing business networking example and dictionary verb.

after.content: 以印刷形式出版；指書籍時，也可表示仍在印行、仍可向出版社購得。單說曾經出版，不必然表示目前仍未絕版。

patches.reason: Retain both attested in-print senses and prevent a universal equivalence with any past publication.
